issuer: the Department of Revenue and Taxation (Motor Vehicle Division)
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Guam Code Annotated, Title 16, Chapter 3, as the Compiler of Laws publishes it (its text of 2026-04-23): Article 1A (graduated driver licensing) sets a learner's permit from fifteen and a half, an intermediate license from 16, and full licensure, which a licensee may have from 17 after the intermediate stage (twelve consecutive months free of fault and conviction to move to Stage 3), so the full licence is held from 17. § 31A08 lets the Director of Revenue and Taxation charge $10.00 for full licensure, valid for three years (the learner's permit's and intermediate license's $10.00 not held); the Department's own schedule (Motor Vehicles Division fees, updated March 2013) gives full licensure at $10.00, and its mail-in packet of 2025 gives converting an intermediate to a full licence at $10.00 plus a $3 postage fee for mail-in (the postage not held). A licence's later renewal ($25 for three years, $45 for five) isn't the first issue's fee and isn't held. The photo identification card: $25.00 new, renewal, replacement or name change (the 2013 schedule; the 2025 packet gives renewals and replacements at $25 plus postage); its term wasn't read and is null. § 3118.1 sets how a foreign licence is exchanged without naming the countries, so no exchange list is held.

sources.said: the minimum age for a learner’s permit is fifteen and one-half (15.5) years ... the minimum age for an Intermediate License is sixteen (16) years ... remain conviction free of all traffic and motor vehicle code violations for twelve (12) consecutive months to move to Stage 3 ... a full licensee must be at least Seventeen (17) years of age ... Stage 3 - Full Licensure $10.00, valid for three years
